title: Additive Subtractive Selection in All Apps
prompt: Get additive and subtractive selection running in all sketchpad apps
summary: Additive/subtractive selection now works consistently across all sketchpad apps. Type.tsx model/connector clicks use applySelectionComposition with activeTool + keyboard. Design.tsx 3D scene uses activeTool. Quality.tsx has selection toolbar with toggles. Locale labels added.
